channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-115204 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The AZEXO Store Locator WordPress plugin through 1.4 does not perform capability or nonce checks on its AJAX actions and does not sanitise a request header used to build a file path, allowing any authenticated user such as a subscriber to write a file with an arbitrary name, location, and content, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-115212 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The mView 豆瓣电影 WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not validate the type, name, or source of a remotely fetched file, nor perform any capability or authorization check, before saving it to a web-accessible directory, allowing any authenticated user such as a subscriber to upload arbitrary PHP files and achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-115213 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The EASY-JS-WPAPI Client HANDLE for the WordPress REST-API WordPress plugin through 2.0 does not prevent the administrator credentials it stores from being disclosed to unauthenticated users and does not correctly verify authentication, allowing unauthenticated attackers to obtain administrator credentials and gain full administrator access to the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-115237 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Grand Job WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not correctly verify the password reset code before updating a user's password, allowing unauthenticated attackers to set the password of arbitrary accounts, including administrators, and fully take over the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-115256 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Mail Debug for WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.3.0 does not perform any capability, authentication, or nonce check on one of its email-logging actions, which is exposed to unauthenticated users and is not restricted to its own data, allowing anyone to read the full body of every email the site has sent, including password-reset emails whose reset key lets an attacker take over an administrator account.

item.title: CVE-2026-118201 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Limit Login Attempts Security WordPress plugin before 3.4.1 does not enforce its two-factor authentication on every password-authentication route, so an attacker who already knows a protected user's password can authenticate through an alternative login interface and obtain that user's access without completing the second factor.

item.title: CVE-2026-118202 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Limit Login Attempts Security WordPress plugin before 3.4.1 does not confirm that its two-factor authentication step succeeded before completing a login and treats a failure to build that step as success, so an attacker who holds a protected user's password can bypass the second factor by sending a request header that breaks the step.

item.title: CVE-2026-120409 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin before 5.1.1 does not check whether a video is password protected before serving it through its standalone player page and its download link, allowing unauthenticated visitors to obtain the media source of password-protected videos, such as unlisted YouTube or Vimeo links and external file URLs.

item.title: CVE-2026-121759 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Fusion Page Builder WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not check that the user owns the content it moves to the trash, which could allow users with a role as low as Contributor to trash arbitrary posts and pages, or delete them permanently where the trash is disabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-121874 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Post Duplicator WordPress plugin before 3.0.18 does not restrict settings saves to its own options, allowing a site administrator on a multisite network who is not a Super Admin to overwrite arbitrary options of their site, including the role definitions, and so grant themselves network-management capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2026-121875 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Post Duplicator WordPress plugin before 3.0.18 does not validate the capabilities assigned to roles through its permissions settings, allowing a site administrator on a multisite network who is not a Super Admin to grant any role arbitrary capabilities, including the network-management capabilities reserved to the Super Admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-123064 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP BASE Booking of Appointments, Services and Events WordPress plugin before 6.5.1 does not properly restrict access to one of its user-creation actions, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access and above to create a new administrator account and thereby escalate their privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-123088 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The UniPAY Payment Gateway For WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.4 does not perform any authorization check before returning an order's order-received URL for an attacker-supplied order id, exposing the order's secret key in the redirect and allowing unauthenticated attackers to enumerate orders and disclose customers' personal data (name, email address, phone number and address).

item.title: CVE-2026-123091 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Vigilant WordPress plugin before 2.11.0 does not enforce its two-factor authentication on login forms other than the default WordPress one, allowing an attacker who knows a user's password to skip the second factor and log in as that user.

item.title: CVE-2026-123128 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The GemBooking WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not serialise concurrent booking requests per team member, allowing unauthenticated users to create overlapping confirmed bookings for the same team member across different bookable items by sending simultaneous requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-123129 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description:
Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not validate the ticket-type price sent to one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions when the referenced product has no ticket types configured, and stores the submitted price site-wide, where it is applied to the next event ticket added to any cart, allowing unauthenticated visitors to buy event tickets at an arbitrary price, including for free.
This is due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-34898.

item.title: CVE-2026-123131 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The GemBooking WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not properly verify that a REST request is addressed to its own routes before temporarily granting staff users administrative capabilities, allowing users with the GemBooking WordPress plugin before 1.7.1's Staff role to delete arbitrary posts and update the site's settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-123145 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WooCommerce Stripe Payment Gateway WordPress plugin before 11.1.0 does not exclude the account password from the checkout fields it saves to order metadata during express checkout, causing the password a customer chooses when creating an account at checkout to be stored in plaintext in the database, readable by anyone with access to order data or the database. Version 10.9.0 stored the passwords. Version 10.9.1 stopped new ones from being stored but left existing ones in place, and version 11.1.0 removes them on update. Passwords stored this way should be considered exposed.

item.title: CVE-2026-123751 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Duplicate WordPress plugin through 1.1.11 does not properly verify a request authentication value and does not validate the path or type of uploaded files, making it possible for unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files to the server and achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild.

item.title: CVE-2026-124572 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | A vulnerability has been found in DataLinkDC dinky up to 1.2.5. Affected by this issue is the function CatalogueController.upload of the file dinky-admin/src/main/java/org/dinky/controller/CatalogueController.java of the component Catalogue Upload API. The manipulation leads to path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

item.title: CVE-2026-124573 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was found in logseq 2.0.1/2.0.2. This affects the function validate-auth-token of the file src/electron/electron/server.cljs of the component Local HTTP API. The manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

item.title: CVE-2026-124574 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was determined in chenyme grok2api up to 3.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function beginSelectionSession of the file backend/internal/application/gateway/video.go of the component Video Job Retry Handler. This manipulation causes improper authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 3.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. Patch name: 199b3abecc14907176dae1f1cacf125419caa94d. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-124575 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | A vulnerability was identified in SiteServer SSCMS up to 7.1.3/7.2.1/7.4.0. This issue affects the function LoginController.Submit of the file src/SSCMS.Web/Controllers/Admin/LoginController.Submit.cs of the component Admin-Login CAPTCHA. Such manipulation of the argument isForceLogoutAndLogin leads to improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. A high complexity level is associated with this attack. The exploitability is assessed as difficult. The name of the patch is df3becb7ebb00a48435418a44fd08a459eb38ace. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

item.title: CVE-2026-124576 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | A security flaw has been discovered in BeikeShop up to 2.0.0.31. Impacted is the function OrderRepo::getOrderByNumber of the file beike/Repositories/OrderRepo.php of the component Guest Order Lookup. Performing a manipulation of the argument order_number results in enforcement of behavioral workflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 2.0.0.32 is recommended to address this issue. The patch is named 6cf25f8c15d27d1ff14a848faf645c94d20ba5f1. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-81422 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Appointment Booking & Scheduling WordPress plugin before 2.7 does not verify the site's user-registration setting before creating accounts through a publicly accessible shortcode, allowing unauthenticated attackers to register arbitrary user accounts, and be automatically logged in, even when user registration is disabled on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-124577 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.9

item.title: CVE-2026-123870 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.5 | The otterdog webapp evaluates a format-string built from the incoming GitHub webhook JSON body using Python's eval(). When the GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET configuration value is unset or empty (the code default is None), the HMAC signature check is skipped entirely, allowing an unauthenticated network client to reach the eval() sink with attacker-controlled input and execute arbitrary Python on the webapp host.
